intro: Heart kaomoji (also spelled heart kamoji) are Japanese-style text faces that carry a ♥ or ♡ — for affection, crushes, and love notes. A heart kaomoji like (♥ω♥) or (´｡• ᵕ •｡`)♡ is plain Unicode text, so it pastes cleanly into bios, captions, comments, and usernames. Browse heart eyes, blown kisses, hearts-in-hands, and sparkly hearts below and click any face to copy it instantly.
